items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: Yeah, he's a place to play with us. ... Yeah, we come up together, me and him.

ctx.x: Ask him if he worked with Bob Thomas ever, Robert Thomas.
You work with Bob Thomas in it? Who? Bob Thomas. Robert Thomas. Palmer? Oh, Palmer. No, Thomas. Thomas Thomas. Robert Thomas.
